nodes.label: Failover behaviour table
nodes.rationale: Timeout/5xx/429 retry once with jitter then next tier; 401/403 skip tier for session; 400 next tier no retry; validation failure rejectLastAnswer then checklist; no network goes straight to LiteRT; circuit breaker after 3 failures for 60 s.
